content.short: Skale is a multichain network that serves as a viable scalability option for EVM projects.
content.description: The Skale network (token: SKL) is a blockchain that provides file storage, an application server, and communication capabilities while pooling security features from Ethereum and other chains. Web3 teams can rely on Skale to streamline onboarding and test ideas on a gasless infrastructure, helping developers prototype concepts quickly without gas costs. By combining storage, compute, and messaging within a secure, interoperable framework, Skale supports smoother development cycles and iterative experimentation for decentralized applications.
